# Biology LibreTexts

> Open-access collaborative platform providing free, customizable biology textbooks, learning objects, and course materials for postsecondary education.

Biology LibreTexts is part of the larger LibreTexts project and hosts peer-reviewed, community-driven biology textbooks and educational resources. The platform serves faculty and students across multiple institutions including UC Davis, Butte College, and other California community colleges, offering customizable course shells, interactive simulations, and comprehensive reference materials.

## Core Navigation

- [Home](https://bio.libretexts.org): LibreTexts Biology hub: open-access collaborative textbooks for postsecondary education
- [Bookshelves](https://bio.libretexts.org/Bookshelves): Curated biology textbooks and customizable content remixes organized by topic
- [Campus Bookshelves](https://bio.libretexts.org/Courses): Customized course shells and text remixes for faculty at partner institutions

## Learning Objects & Interactive Tools

- [Learning Objects](https://bio.libretexts.org/Learning_Objects): Laboratory experiments, visualizations, simulations, and databases for active learning
- [Visualizations and Simulations](https://bio.libretexts.org/Visualizations_and_Simulations): Interactive PhET simulations and molecular models for biology concepts
- [LOV Domains](https://bio.libretexts.org/Learning_Objects/Photoreceptor_Depot/LOV_Domains): Plant photoreceptors and blue-light response mechanisms reference
- [UVR8](https://bio.libretexts.org/Learning_Objects/Photoreceptor_Depot/UVR8): UV-B sensing and plant stress response in Arabidopsis photoreceptor reference

## Introductory Biology Courses

- [BIS 2A: Introductory Biology (Facciotti)](https://bio.libretexts.org/LibreTexts/University_of_California_Davis/BIS_2A%3A_Introductory_Biology_(Facciotti)): UC Davis BIS 2A covering cellular basis, genetics, and metabolism
- [BC: BIOL 2 - Introduction to Human Biology (Grewal)](https://bio.libretexts.org/Courses/Butte_College/BC%3A_BIOL_2_-_Introduction_to_Human_Biology_(Grewal)): Butte College introductory human biology survey course materials

## Institution Course Catalogs

- [Butte College](https://bio.libretexts.org/Courses/Butte_College): Biology survey and introductory course materials from Butte College

## Specialized Topics

- [Buffers, Polyprotic Acids, and Amphoteric Substances](https://bio.libretexts.org/Courses/University_of_California_Davis/BIS_102%3A_Structure_and_Function_of_Biomolecules_(Gasser)/04%3A%09Buffers%2C_Polyprotic_acids%3B_Amphoteric_Substances%2C): UC Davis BIS 102 chapter on buffers, polyprotic acids, and amphoteric substances in biochemistry
